Paella is a traditional recipe that celebrates flavors and skill in a one-pan meal. As tasty as it is filling, this classic rice dish is known for its well-done bottom crust called "soccarat" to provide a crispy contrast to the tender textures of meat, seafood and vegetables. The Babish Paella Pan is the right pan to meet all the specific requirements to serve up a traditional paella dish, transporting you and your guests to Valencia - a small village in Spain where paella originated from. The wide shape and sloping sides maximize the heat to reduce broth and sear food evenly.  Safe on all stovetops, this non-reactive stainless-steel pan features double-riveted side handles to offer balance when lifting and serving. Oven safe up to 500°F. Hand wash recommended.
Andrew Rea is one part chef, one part filmmaker, and a generous dash of irreverent Youtube personality. Self-taught both behind and in front of the camera, his Youtube channel, Babish Culinary Universe, is enjoyed by millions of burgeoning chefs and foodies around the globe. His passion for teaching and experimenting in the kitchen is rivaled only by his love of film and television, both of which he endeavors to share from his Brooklyn, NY kitchen.
* One 13-inch stainless steel paella pan* Tri-ply stainless steel construction for durability* Encapsulated aluminum core promotes uniform heating * Nonreactive interior creates evenly caramelized paella crusts* Sloping slides allow the broth and the food to distribute and cook uniformly * Compatible with induction, gas, electric, halogen, glass and ceramic stovetops* Oven safe up to 500°F * Hand wash recommended

products.description:
Paella is a traditional recipe that celebrates flavors and skill in a one-pan meal. As tasty as it is filling, this classic rice dish is known for its well-done bottom crust called "soccarat" to provide a crispy contrast to the tender textures of meat, seafood and vegetables. The Babish Paella Pan is the right pan to meet all the specific requirements to serve up a traditional paella dish, transporting you and your guests to Valencia - a small village in Spain where paella originated from. The paella pan's tri-ply stainless steel construction encapsulates a seamless aluminum core for uniform heat absorption and distribution from the base to the rim. The wide shape and sloping sides maximize the heat to reduce broth and sear food evenly.  Safe on all stovetops, this non-reactive stainless-steel pan features double-riveted side handles to offer balance when lifting and serving. Oven safe up to 500°F. Hand wash recommended.
Andrew Rea is one part chef, one part filmmaker, and a generous dash of irreverent Youtube personality. Self-taught both behind and in front of the camera, his Youtube channel, Babish Culinary Universe, is enjoyed by millions of burgeoning chefs and foodies around the globe. His passion for teaching and experimenting in the kitchen is rivaled only by his love of film and television, both of which he endeavors to share from his Brooklyn, NY kitchen.
* One 13-inch stainless steel paella pan* Tri-ply stainless steel construction for durability* Encapsulated aluminum core promotes uniform heating * Nonreactive interior creates evenly caramelized paella crusts* Sloping slides allow the broth and the food to distribute and cook uniformly * Compatible with induction, gas, electric, halogen, glass and ceramic stovetops* Oven safe up to 500°F * Hand wash recommended

products.description:
Sear, sauté, and simmer with elevated precision using the Swiss Diamond CXD Nonstick Fry Pan with Glass Lid, an everyday essential designed for versatility, control, and consistent results. Built for home cooks who value performance without compromise, it brings refined functionality to daily cooking.

Description

Made in Switzerland from 100% recycled aluminum, this fry pan combines sustainable craftsmanship with professional-grade performance. Its durable cast aluminum body ensures fast, even heat distribution while resisting warping and hot spots for reliable everyday cooking.

At the core is Swiss Diamond’s advanced CXD dual-layer ceramic nonstick system, featuring a plasma-hardened base layer for strength and a diamond-infused ceramic topcoat for smooth food release and long-lasting durability. Made without PFAS, PTFE, PFOA, lead, or cadmium, it supports cleaner cooking with little to no added oil.

The ergonomic stainless steel handle provides secure, comfortable control, while the tempered glass lid helps retain moisture and flavor while allowing you to monitor cooking without lifting the lid.

Features and Benefits


  Dual-layer ceramic nonstick coating
  Diamond-infused surface for effortless food release
  Made without PFAS, PTFE, PFOA, lead, or cadmium
  Includes tempered glass lid
  Crafted from 100% recycled aluminum
  Fast, even heat distribution with reduced hot spots
  Compatible with all cooktops, including induction
  Ergonomic stainless steel handle for secure control
  Oven safe up to 500°F (260°C)


Designed for everyday versatility, this fry pan transitions seamlessly from stovetop to oven for a wide range of cooking styles and techniques.

Specifications

Cooktop Compatibility
Gas, Electric, Ceramic, Induction

Materials
100% recycled cast aluminum, dual-layer ceramic nonstick coating with diamond-infused topcoat, stainless steel handle, tempered glass lid

Use and Care

For best results, use low to medium heat and avoid overheating an empty pan. We recommend hand washing with warm, soapy water to preserve the ceramic nonstick surface and maintain long-term performance.

products.description:
Paella is a traditional recipe that celebrates flavors and skill in a one-pan meal. As tasty as it is filling, this classic rice dish is known for its well-done bottom crust called "soccarat" to provide a crispy contrast to the tender textures of meat, seafood and vegetables. The Babish Paella Pan is the right pan to meet all the specific requirements to serve up a traditional paella dish, transporting you and your guests to Valencia - a small village in Spain where paella originated from. The paella pan's tri-ply stainless steel construction encapsulates a seamless aluminum core for uniform heat absorption and distribution from the base to the rim. The wide shape and sloping sides maximize the heat to reduce broth and sear food evenly.  Safe on all stovetops, this non-reactive stainless-steel pan features double-riveted side handles to offer balance when lifting and serving. Oven safe up to 500°F. Hand wash recommended.
Andrew Rea is one part chef, one part filmmaker, and a generous dash of irreverent Youtube personality. Self-taught both behind and in front of the camera, his Youtube channel, Babish Culinary Universe, is enjoyed by millions of burgeoning chefs and foodies around the globe. His passion for teaching and experimenting in the kitchen is rivaled only by his love of film and television, both of which he endeavors to share from his Brooklyn, NY kitchen.
* One 13-inch stainless steel paella pan* Tri-ply stainless steel construction for durability* Encapsulated aluminum core promotes uniform heating * Nonreactive interior creates evenly caramelized paella crusts* Sloping slides allow the broth and the food to distribute and cook uniformly * Compatible with induction, gas, electric, halogen, glass and ceramic stovetops* Oven safe up to 500°F * Hand wash recommended

The Babish Paella Pan is the right pan to meet all the specific requirements to serve up a traditional paella dish, transporting you and your guests to Valencia - a small village in Spain where paella originated from. Oven safe up to 500°F. Hand wash recommended.

Self-taught both behind and in front of the camera, his Youtube channel, Babish Culinary Universe, is enjoyed by millions of burgeoning chefs and foodies around the globe. His passion for teaching and experimenting in the kitchen is rivaled only by his love of film and television, both of which he endeavors to share from his Brooklyn, NY kitchen.

products.description:
Immerse yourself in the heritage of the CRISTEL® brand with our new 1826® collection.
This 18/10 stainless steel frying pan with a brushed finish reflects a rich history, which was a turning point in the world of cookware.
1826® saw the creation of the world’s first stamped saucepan, manufactured at our factory in Fesches-le-Châtel, France. Nearly two centuries later, this new collection, symbolically named 1826®, takes its inspiration from the past while embodying the modernity, innovation, and passion that drive CRISTEL® every day. 
Our 1826® frying pan stands out thanks to its tapered base, paying tribute to the two-hundred-year-old saucepan that gave rise to this collection. It is available in 5 sizes/ diameters: 8“ / 9.50“ / 10“ / 11“ / 12“. 
Its induction-compatible, heat-diffusing base in three superimposed layers (induction stainless steel - aluminum - 18/10 stainless steel) guarantees even heat distribution across its entire surface, so you can sear a piece of meat or sauté a medley of vegetables effortlessly, without the need to add fat.
For cooking fish, potatoes, or eggs, opt for the 1826® Non-stick Frying Pan.
In addition to its performance, this pan is designed for compact storage, optimizing space in your kitchen.
Its heat-resistant, ergonomic, and firmly riveted handle does not conduct heat, providing a pleasant grip with no risk of burns, assuring enhanced safety in the kitchen.
For optimized heat distribution, enhance your stainless steel cookware with our Glass Lid from the 1826® collection.
Explore our wide range of CRISTEL® Frying Pans available on our website, for even more choice.

Paella is a traditional recipe that celebrates flavors and skill in a one-pan meal. As tasty as it is filling, this classic rice dish is known for its well-done bottom crust called "soccarat" to provide a crispy contrast to the tender textures of meat, seafood and vegetables. The Babish Paella Pan is the right pan to meet all the specific requirements to serve up a traditional paella dish, transporting you and your guests to Valencia - a small village in Spain where paella originated from. The paella pan's tri-ply stainless steel construction encapsulates a seamless aluminum core for uniform heat absorption and distribution from the base to the rim. The wide shape and sloping sides maximize the heat to reduce broth and sear food evenly.  Safe on all stovetops, this non-reactive stainless-steel pan features double-riveted side handles to offer balance when lifting and serving. Oven safe up to 500°F. Hand wash recommended.
Andrew Rea is one part chef, one part filmmaker, and a generous dash of irreverent Youtube personality. Self-taught both behind and in front of the camera, his Youtube channel, Babish Culinary Universe, is enjoyed by millions of burgeoning chefs and foodies around the globe. His passion for teaching and experimenting in the kitchen is rivaled only by his love of film and television, both of which he endeavors to share from his Brooklyn, NY kitchen.

products.description:
Paella is a traditional recipe that celebrates flavors and skill in a one-pan meal. As tasty as it is filling, this classic rice dish is known for its well-done bottom crust called "soccarat" to provide a crispy contrast to the tender textures of meat, seafood and vegetables. The Babish Paella Pan is the right pan to meet all the specific requirements to serve up a traditional paella dish, transporting you and your guests to Valencia - a small village in Spain where paella originated from. The paella pan's tri-ply stainless steel construction encapsulates a seamless aluminum core for uniform heat absorption and distribution from the base to the rim. The wide shape and sloping sides maximize the heat to reduce broth and sear food evenly.  Safe on all stovetops, this non-reactive stainless-steel pan features double-riveted side handles to offer balance when lifting and serving. Oven safe up to 500°F. Hand wash recommended.
Andrew Rea is one part chef, one part filmmaker, and a generous dash of irreverent Youtube personality. Self-taught both behind and in front of the camera, his Youtube channel, Babish Culinary Universe, is enjoyed by millions of burgeoning chefs and foodies around the globe. His passion for teaching and experimenting in the kitchen is rivaled only by his love of film and television, both of which he endeavors to share from his Brooklyn, NY kitchen.
* One 13-inch stainless steel paella pan* Tri-ply stainless steel construction for durability* Encapsulated aluminum core promotes uniform heating * Nonreactive interior creates evenly caramelized paella crusts* Sloping slides allow the broth and the food to distribute and cook uniformly * Compatible with induction, gas, electric, halogen, glass and ceramic stovetops* Oven safe up to 500°F * Hand wash recommended
